info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Institution Login Id Reconnection-spec
info.description: The Institution Login ID Reconnection API enables businesses to facilitate the re-establishment of institution login IDs for customers. This endpoint allows authorized users to initiate reconnection requests for specified customer accounts, enhancing user access continuity. It is particularly useful for financial institutions and service providers aiming to streamline their account management processes. Typical consumers of this API include customer service representatives and automated systems handling account recovery tasks.

post.summary: Reconnect a previously disconnected institution login ID for a customer.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to reconnect an institution login ID that was previously disconnected for a specified customer. Ensure you provide all required information to successfully complete the reconnection process.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate reconnection for a specified institution login ID associated with the customer. It requires data formatted as JSON, following the specified schema, to successfully process the reconnection request.
